name: Sunray Burlington 2-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna
description: Sunray Burlington HL200D The Burlington outdoor infrared sauna has deep bench seating in the rear and comfortably seats 2 people. Seven ceramic heaters will quickly get the sauna to your desired temperature up to 140 degrees. The Burlington is the perfect size for a back yard patio. This sauna includes an oxygen ionization system for purifying the air, recessed interior lighting, Bluetooth speakers, cup holders, and more. The Burlington is easy to assemble and the natural Canadian hemlock wood will enhance any outdoor patio setting. Features & Specifications: Exterior Dimensions: 57" x 45.3" x 83" - Cabin Dimensions 48" x 39" x 83". Rapid-Heat ceramic heaters - 6 Rapid Heat ceramic heaters gets the sauna to your desired temperature in just minutes! Bluetooth speaker system. Severe weather cover. Easy to install tongue and groove construction. ETL/CSA Certified - Meets all US and Canadian electrical safety standards - 120V, 20 amp plug. 7-Year Structural Warranty - Guaranteed against defects in materials and workmanship for a full 7 years. 20 Amps, 120V AC. Measurements: Exterior width: 57" Exterior depth: 45" Exterior height: 83" Interior height: 68" Interior width 43" Interior depth 41" Product weight: 301 lbs.
